faq_heading: New construction in Sardis: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Sardis where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Sardis?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were condos in Garrison Crossing: median build year 2019, 44 sales, median price $491,500.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Sardis?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was condos in Vedder Crossing: 4 days to sell at a median, closing at 97.7% of the list price.

items.t: Garrison Crossing condos: 44 sold at a median of $491,500 (middle half between $417,250 and $680,250), taking 23 days at 97.3% of the list price, with a median build year of 2019. The typical home had 2 bedrooms, it sold for about $598 per square foot, strata fees were a median $362 a month and 2% of the sales closed over the list price. The median moved from $409,950 (November to January) to $447,450 (August to October).

In Garrison Crossing, the 24 houses that sold had a median build year of 2010 and a median price of $1,192,500; the middle half closed between $1,032,125 and $1,284,750, after 38 days on the market at 98.1% of list.
